title: The Grunion Run, 2003 · after
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: The Monday after: the thermos on the shack's counter, empty, and a stranger coming in for a coffee and calling Gully by name. Wood on the crate watching the town have found him. Gully doesn't notice being found.

panels.composition: The shack. The empty thermos on the counter. GULLY. WOOD on the crate. A stranger in the door.

balloons.text: Gully — that coffee from Friday. You sell it?
